messages.text: I applied for a refund on my seat cushion while I was still within the deadline, but the staff member rejected it. Surely that first request keeps my refund window open?

messages.text: I’m sorry, but the rejected request does not keep the refund window open. The records show your seat cushion was received back, but the earlier proposal was rejected, so it does not count as an on-time proposal that preserves a later request. The deadline was November 8, 2026, and a new request now is too late. (refund-policy/v2/return) (refund-policy/v2/window)
